svg.title: Choose a Devin mode for the job
svg.desc: Choose based on whether you need to read files, edit them locally or run tests in the cloud. Read a project. Use Ask or DeepWiki to find the source of a rule. Edit locally. Use the command-line tool, or CLI, in your project folder. Work in the cloud. Start an Agent session. A saved snapshot can provide the tools the tests need.
